    The local structure of a finite-dimensional scalar mesh category #

    Proof of Lemma 2.7: "The positive-degree ideal is nilpotent, each degree-zero endomorphism ring is k, and degree-zero maps between distinct objects vanish; so this ideal is the categorical radical." For a finite-dimensional scalar mesh category on a finite translation quiver we take as radical the span of the images of paths of positive length (radN 1) and verify the axioms of LocalFamily.

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.
